series.name: Genovus Just Knows
series.logline: Agency life is loud. The agent with Genovus stays calm, because tomorrow is already handled. Every episode ends the same way: “Genovus just knows.”

bible.premise: Each episode drops our agents into something absurd and loud: a show, a strange appointment, a late-night meeting. Two of them realize they forgot something that matters. The third checks Genovus, and it's already handled. She breaks the fourth wall: “Genovus just knows.”
bible.tone: Comedy first, warm, a little absurd, never mean. Under 60 seconds. Hook in the first 1.5 seconds. Music-driven, captions always on.

rules: Trend Remix: build on viral moments only through the platform’s own Stitch/Remix (their first seconds, credited and linked, in-app, when the creator allows remixing), a written license from the creator, or an original made in the same energy. Never download, re-upload or imitate a specific person, character or video.
Original characters only. The reference reels set the energy; their footage, music, performers and look are never used.
The phone shows the real Genovus app, filmed from a demo agency (fictional data), never real customers.
The claim is narrow and true: follow-ups you log are lined up by day, so tomorrow's list is ready the night before.
No carrier names or logos, no quotes, no coverage claims, no promises of results.
AI-generated footage is labeled on every platform. Music is original or licensed for commercial use.
Every post is approved in the Studio desk before it goes out, and the live link is recorded after.
bible.look: Vertical 9:16, 35mm film look, warm practical light, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, handheld energy in the crowd and locked-off calm on Maya.

platform_notes.facebook: Link works in the caption. Turn on the AI info label when uploading.
platform_notes.instagram: Links aren't clickable in captions: put the tracked link in bio (or a link sticker in Stories). Turn on the AI info label.
platform_notes.tiktok: Put the tracked link in bio. Turn on “AI-generated content” in the post settings.
platform_notes.youtube: Upload as a Short (vertical, under 60s). In Details, answer Yes to “altered or synthetic content”. Put the tracked link in the description and pin it as the first comment.

genome.aspect: set by the cut: 16:9 for the home page, 9:16 for social
genome.lenses: 28 mm for groups, 40 mm for singles and two-shots, 65 mm for close reactions (full-frame equivalents)
genome.camera: eye level; mostly locked off; a move only when the story motivates it; the camera never tells the joke
genome.depth: shallow but readable: the background stays legible
genome.lighting: motivated: soft window key from camera left plus practical desk lamps; restrained contrast
genome.skin: natural texture, real pores, no beauty filter
genome.color: warm neutrals; Genovus orange appears only through props and screens, never as a color cast
genome.texture: subtle 35 mm grain, gentle halation on highlights
genome.reactions: medium close-ups and close-ups; hold the reaction longer than feels safe
forbidden: wardrobe or prop drift between shots
haze or smoke without a source
any legible text on screens or paper (real screens are cut in)

0–5 · ORIGINAL PERFORMANCE (their reel, in-app). No added exposition.

5–12 · Audience three-shot, Bri reaction. TRENT, leaning in: “Tell me tomorrow’s call list is ready.” BRI, smile fading: “I thought you made it.” TRENT: “Oh, we’re cooked.” Maya keeps watching the stage.

12–16 · BRI turns toward Maya: “Maya. You hearing this?” MAYA, eyes still on the performance: “Unfortunately.”

37–43 · Maya finishes the shared reaction, turns to the lens, the room recedes in the mix. MAYA, quietly certain: “Genovus just knows.” Small smile. Trent and Bri never look into the lens.

43–45 · Brief brand finish. Keep Maya’s final face visible long enough to land.

episodes.title: Intro · Genovus Knows
episodes.logline: Monday at the office: Trent is drowning in email, Bri’s sticky-note system is falling off her monitor, and Maya already knows what’s in the day. She walks them (and us) through the real Genovus screens: Today, Follow-ups, Approvals, Performance and Care. Everyone gets a win; Genovus just knows.
episodes.script:
0–8 · COLD OPEN. Trent at his laptop, the unread count climbing (insert graphic). TRENT: “Quick question. Is it normal for email to multiply?” Bri’s desk: a sticky note drops off her monitor. BRI: “I have a system.” Another falls. “…Had a system.”

8–14 · Maya walks in with coffee. TRENT: “How are you calm? It’s Monday.” MAYA: “It’s Monday for me too. I just already know what’s in it.” She turns her phone toward them.

14–24 · REAL SCREEN: Today (phone). MAYA (VO): “My calls are ready the night before. Who, when, and why. Anything urgent stays on top.”

24–34 · TRENT: “The Garcias emailed me three days ago…” REAL SCREEN: Follow-ups, the Garcia renewal on the right day. MAYA (VO): “It’s already on your list. With the date.” TRENT, seeing the exposure, already dialing: “Renewal’s in fourteen days. I’m calling. With urgency.”

34–42 · BRI, holding up her sticky notes: “My follow-ups live here.” REAL SCREEN: Bri logs the Thompsons on her phone in seconds. MAYA (VO): “Log it once, in seconds. It comes back the day it’s due.” BRI: “Thompsons. New baby. That’s my kind of call.”

42–50 · TRENT: “Who’s approving all this?” REAL SCREEN: Approvals, one tap, then the approval record. MAYA (VO): “Nothing goes public until you tap approve. And there’s a record of every decision.”

50–58 · BRI: “Is any of it working?” REAL SCREEN: Performance, link by link. MAYA (VO): “Every lead shows where it came from. Which post. Which page.”

58–64 · REAL SCREEN: Monthly care, a request typed and sent, then the content calendar. MAYA (VO): “Need a change? Ask right here. Your posts are already on the calendar.”

64–70 · TRENT: “Can it write my emails too?” CONCEPT INSERT, labeled In development: a Helix draft waiting for one tap. MAYA (VO): “Helix drafts. You send. You’re still the one they trust.”

70–76 · PAYOFF. TRENT, leaning back: “Great. I was never worried.” BRI, flat: “You said ‘we’re cooked’ four times.” The laugh breaks; Bri crumples her last sticky note.

76–80 · SIGNATURE. Maya to the lens, the room recedes: “Genovus just knows.” End card: GEN·egg·VUS · Book your setup call · AI label.

VERTICAL CUT (30–45 s, social): native 9:16 takes (shots ending in 5, codes ending V) for the cold open, Maya’s entrance, Trent’s call, the payoff and the signature, around the phone captures (Today, add a follow-up, Approvals). Captions burned in for sound-off.
